generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen edit with the edit target as Image 1 and the style canon as reference-only Image 2

authorityConflict.conflict: The generic context paragraph says grey areas are arriving island ground, while this cell's exact north-edge map says the island supplies sea across the complete seam and explicitly forbids rock, beach, or stacks across it.
authorityConflict.ruling: The exact cell edge map and explicit final-sea rule are more specific and therefore govern. The grey placeholder was prompted as open sea; no new land was requested.

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin undirected land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and their four immediate neighbours are excluded, as are gradients below 12 luminance units.
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell sun gradient or long cast-shadow field is visible, but exposed rock motifs repeatedly have pale top caps and darker vertical faces. The literal same-value-on-every-side rule is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual estimated fractions of the non-water footprint at native source resolution.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The non-water footprint consists of exposed offshore stack bodies. Their vertical faces count as steep; broken caps and talus count as other terrain. None forms a credible occupiable shelf. Approximate uncertainty is plus or minus 0.08 per land-relative fraction.

crown.method: Full visual census of the native source found no conifer crowns or other trees.

waterMask.encoding: Opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha.
waterMask.method: Flooded edge-connected teal and blue source pixels, grew through adjacent pale wash, reflections, ripple highlights, and submerged-rock strokes, retained talus beside substantial dry stack bodies, removed stranded classifier specks, and kept the single connected coastal water body.
waterMask.visualInspection: Native overlay inspection found the open sea, submerged reef texture, pale strokes, reflections, wash between exposed rocks, and water around every stack included; dry stack solids remain outside the mask.

refusalReasons: The exact edge map requires sea on all four edges. The raw source retains 545 dry-rock pixels on the east edge, 610 on the south edge, and 584 on the west edge.

The source contains many repeated mirrored stack groups in regular rows, not the permitted one or two close-in skerries; the repeated horizontal motif bands also violate the no line or texture-character shift rule.
Repeated pale rock caps over darker vertical faces violate the literal neutral-lighting rule despite the absence of a whole-cell sun gradient or long cast shadows.
openRisks: The result was square, so it did not qualify for the framing-only retry; a second edit would violate the one-call limit.
The water mask follows the refused raw source and deliberately does not relabel incorrect dry edge rocks as water.
Buildable and steep fractions are manual screen-space estimates rather than surveyed terrain geometry.
Seam continuity, exact wet-pixel boundary judgment, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report makes no visual acceptance claim.
